answer_1.quote: Large and Very Large Language Models (LLMs/VLLMs) have set a new standard for natural language generation (NLG), producing fluent and accurate text across a host of applications such as text simplification , image captioning , and question answering .
answer_1.outputs: The paper addresses data-to-text generation, a subfield of NLG, focusing on generating long-form texts from structured data inputs such as DBpedia triples.

answer_3.quote: For assessing the quality of the different outputs, we ran and averaged the scores assigned by two different LLMs, GPT-o3 and Claudesonnet-3.7, two of the best models currently available.
